selection_rule: Three diverse libero_90 language tasks already listed in the expert-replay gate: pick-and-place bowl, drawer-plus-bowl, and book-in-caddy. They are not the three held-out libero_goal targets. Episode prefixes follow first-N in ascending episode_index once pinned metadata is present; IDs are not invented offline. Hyperparameters are frozen from this set before any real-target grid.

black_bowl_plate.task_text: put the middle black bowl on the plate

drawer_bowl.task_text: open the top drawer of the cabinet and put the bowl in it

book_caddy.task_text: pick up the book and place it in the front compartment of the caddy
